localWasmBuild: cargo build -p flarellm-web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release; wasm-bindgen --target web, workspace +simd128; no wasm-opt
browserHarness: isolated Playwright Chromium, not personal Chrome/browser-harness
referenceClientArchitecture: x86_64 via Rosetta; numerical oracle only, not a performance comparison
sampling: none; exactly one prefill per decision; f64 softmax on offered labels
loadTiming: fresh engine, local disk/localhost, potentially warm filesystem cache; no internet download
memoryCaveat: RSS snapshots are not peaks; renderer RSS includes JS/WASM/browser allocations and excludes other processes. WASM linear capacity is recorded separately in browser-results.json.
timingCaveat: Shared host; some native timing overlapped local builds/tests and some browser timing overlapped a small SwiftShader regression run. No stable performance gate.
